title: 안개처럼 왔어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated textures in the background. The vocal performance is intimate, utilizing breathy delivery in the lower register and transitioning to a more resonant chest voice. The tempo is 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The production features long-tail plate reverb on the vocals and piano, creating a wide stereo image. No percussion or bass is present in this segment.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained grand piano chords, clean electric guitar arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
대화가 줄었어
언제부터인지 몰라
텔레비전 소리가
우리 대신 말해
식탁에 둘이 앉아
눈은 핸드폰에
고개 들면 네가 있어
아무 말도 없어
있는데 없는 것 같아
